headline: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia
angle: The chipmaker offering to guarantee a customer's loan for buying its own chips is a circular deal that a bank officer would find alarming and the executive finds reassuring.
scene: Interior of a bank loan office with a wood desk and a framed photo of a server rack on the wall. A nervous loan officer in a cardigan sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of paperwork labeled 'Nscale – West Virginia Data Center.' Across from the officer sits a relaxed man in a black leather jacket, one hand resting on a small stack of GPU boxes stamped 'Nvidia.' A cosigner signature line on the form is circled in red ink.
setup: So if the data center can't make its payments...
punchline: Then we'll sell them more chips to fix it.
instagram_caption: A chip company offers to guarantee the loan for the customer buying its chips. The bank has some questions.
